assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap module for the original fan-made 2D side-scrolling game Yautja: La Longue Chasse.
The four supplied images are ACTUAL V21 SHIP SCENES, reference only for materials, palette, painterly detail and front elevation. Create only the one new isolated object described below; do not copy the screenshot or include its text, UI, neighboring room or collectible trophies.
Match the existing blackened gunmetal, worn ancient bronze, small restrained cyan or amber lights, dense carved alien-industrial paneling. Camera absolutely orthographic, straight front elevation for a 2D lateral game, no oblique view, no vanishing point or foreshortening. Crisp game-ready silhouette, readable at small gameplay scale.
Output one object on a perfectly uniform near-white #FAFAFA background for authorized technical alpha extraction afterwards. NO painted checkerboard and no shadow cast onto background, no scenery, floor plane, labels, letters, numbers, symbols resembling readable text, logos, watermark or character. The object must be original fan-made architecture, no copied official movie asset.
All extremities within the canvas, with clear margin, no cropped-off parts. Metallic object should be dark/bronze rather than white so the silhouette is distinct from the plain background.
ASSET SPECIFICATION:
Landscape 1536x1024 source. ONE long low solid spacecraft DECK EDGE cassette, straight horizontal side/front elevation, approximately 1360 pixels wide and 150 pixels high in the center. Walkable top is a single perfectly straight horizontal line, no objects projecting above it. A dense dark bronze fascia with horizontal seams, bolted segments and small drainage slots below top, mild amber marker recesses. Left and right ends are straight flush vertical cuts, identical height/material so copies can meet. No support legs, stairs, vertical posts, no perspective top surface. It will repeat along a floor at 20 world units high; the collision top is supplied separately by code.
